article: articles listing the sections of the tribunal and their division into chambers
why: CPCA article 32 says the court is made of sections but the list of sections (including misdemeanours, contraventions, minors) and their division into chambers is set by the judicial-organisation text, which is not in the store.

CPCA article 531 gives the commercial section 'commercial disputes' without defining them; the definition of commercial acts (Commercial Code articles 1 to 4) would ground the proposed slot dispute_is_commercial.

article: the text setting the seats and installation of the specialised commercial courts
why: Law 22-13 article 13 defers the jurisdiction of the specialised commercial courts (CPCA 536 bis) to their installation; without the installation text and date the boundary between the commercial section and those courts cannot be dated (open point o4).

article: provisions on the misdemeanours, contraventions and minors sections
why: Checklist lines on the criminal and minors sections of the court; not in the store.
